title: Fungal Infestation
html:
This article is about the action learned by Circle of the Spores druids. For the similar action used by Spaw, see Animating Spores.
Fungal Infestation is a action gained by Circle of the Spores druids at level 6 that allows them to raise a  Fungal Zombie from a nearby corpse using a resource exclusive to this action.

Description

Raises a mildewed, mould-encrusted zombie from a corpse.

Target must be a beast or humanoid corpse.

Properties

Cost
 Reaction +  Fungal Infestation Charge
Details
 Range: 3 m (10 ft)

How to learn

Classes:
  • Class level 6: Circle of the Spores

Notes

  • Circle of the Spores druids get  4 Fungal Infestation Charges at class level 6. These recharge on a long rest.

Bugs

  • Fungal Infestation can create infinite zombies at the end of Act Two using the recovery station before the boss fight to regain charges paired with being able to raise an Intellect Devourer even after their corpse has been used.
